tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.tagline: Draft, research, and analyze business files.
tools.description: Choose ChatGPT when the same owner needs to work across writing, source research, and business files. Its breadth is useful for a shop that has several small, recurring tasks rather than one specialized department. A reusable Project can hold a fact sheet and instructions, but the owner still needs to distinguish supplied facts from suggestions. Start with a checkable output, such as a listing draft with every product claim mapped to the original specification.

An owner comparing or summarizing files they are allowed to upload
Repeated tasks that can share a small, maintained business brief
notFor: Unattended publication of product, shipping, or refund promises
Sensitive customer records without an appropriate account and data controls
limitations: A fluent draft can still add an unsupported feature; verify every material claim.
Projects retain shared context, so remove obsolete policies and check sharing before uploading business files.
